title: Identify charter schools that are exclusively virtual and serve grades 9–12
question: Identify charter schools that are exclusively virtual and serve grades 9–12. Among these, find those located in counties where at least one school has an SAT excellence rate above 0.25. For each such school, return its name, charter number, county, and its rank in average math score within its county.

prediction.sql:
WITH sat_excellent_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_034 AS county
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.XCL_036 > 0 AND CAST(s.XCL_040 AS REAL) / s.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
charter_virtual_high AS (
    SELECT
        sc.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        sc.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
        sc.XCL_045 AS county,
        sat.XCL_037 AS avg_math_score
    FROM schools sc
    INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sc.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE sc.XCL_063 = 1
      AND sc.XCL_076 = 'F'
      AND sc.XCL_074 = '9-12'
      AND sc.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM sat_excellent_counties)
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    charter_number,
    county,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_math_score DESC) AS rank_in_county
FROM charter_virtual_high

WITH sat_excellent_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_034 AS county
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.XCL_036 > 0 AND CAST(s.XCL_040 AS REAL) / s.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
charter_virtual_high AS (
    SELECT
        sc.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        sc.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
        sc.XCL_045 AS county,
        sat.XCL_037 AS avg_math_score
    FROM schools sc
    INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sc.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE sc.XCL_063 = 1
      AND sc.XCL_076 = 'F'
      AND sc.XCL_074 = '9-12'
      AND sc.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM sat_excellent_counties)
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    charter_number,
    county,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_math_score DESC) AS rank_in_county
FROM charter_virtual_high

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH sat_excellent_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_045 AS county
    FROM satscores s
    INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.XCL_030 = sc.XCL_041
    WHERE CAST(s.XCL_040 AS REAL) / s.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
charter_virtual_high AS (
    SELECT
        sc.XCL_042 AS school_name,
        f.XCL_003 AS charter_number,
        sc.XCL_045 AS county,
        f.XCL_025 / f.XCL_024 AS avg_math_score
    FROM frpm f
    INNER JOIN schools sc ON f.XCL_001 = sc.XCL_041
    WHERE f.XCL_003 IS NOT NULL
      AND f.XCL_011 = 'Virtual'
      AND f.XCL_017 = '9'
      AND f.XCL_018 = '12'
      AND sc.XCL_045 IN (SELECT county FROM sat_excellent_counties)
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    charter_number,
    county,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_math_score DESC) AS rank_in_county
FROM charter_virtual_high

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH virtual_charter_high AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_041 AS school_id,
        s.XCL_042 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_043 AS charter_number,
        s.XCL_044 AS county
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Charter'
      AND s.XCL_046 = 'Virtual'
      AND s.XCL_047 LIKE '%9%'
      AND s.XCL_047 LIKE '%12%'
),
sat_excellent_counties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.XCL_044 AS county
    FROM satscores sat
    JOIN schools s ON sat.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
    WHERE sat.XCL_038 > 0.25
),
county_avg_math AS (
    SELECT
        s.XCL_044 AS county,
        AVG(sat.XCL_039) AS avg_math
    FROM satscores sat
    JOIN schools s ON sat.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
    GROUP BY s.XCL_044
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        vch.school_id,
        vch.school_name,
        vch.charter_number,
        vch.county,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY vch.county
            ORDER BY COALESCE(sat.XCL_039, 0) DESC
        ) AS math_rank
    FROM virtual_charter_high vch
    JOIN sat_excellent_counties sec ON vch.county = sec.county
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON vch.school_id = sat.XCL_030
)
SELECT
    rs.school_name,
    rs.charter_number,
    rs.county,
    rs.math_rank
FROM ranked_schools rs
